pedal: Boss BF-3 Flanger, STANDARD mode (mono: Guitar In -> Output A)
comment: Checks for the Standard model (captures/boss/bf-3/README.md), all click trains read like the main session's: Depth's floor blend at a second Manual position for Depth 9:00 and 3:00 (measured there only at Manual 12:00), the Rate smoothing at full Depth (measured only at Depth 12:00), and Res with the sweep running. Clock positions: 7:00 = fully counter-clockwise, 5:00 = fully clockwise. Last: the Manual 7:00 sweep without and then with a plug in Output B (the other end loose), to see whether B in use changes what Output A carries (on the CE-5 it made A wet-only).
